pairs.question: Dicite, gentiles populi, cui gloria regi Talis in orbe fuit? Cui palmis compta vel umquam Frondibus arboreis laudem caelestibus ymnis Obvia turba dedit?
pairs.answer: Domino nisi cum patre Christo, Qui regit aetherium princeps in principe regnum.
pairs.derivation: Authorial double rhetorical question (to whom did such royal glory belong; to whom did the crowd offer praise) answered by the author himself. Stripped inline verse number 305 (after 'umquam') and 'Domino' here is the operative answering clause beginning at line 307. Answer ends at the full stop after 'regnum' (line 308); the following line 313 '<Cui Sanctus semper conregnat Spiritus aeque.>' is a separate bracketed editorial supplement and is excluded.
